## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Requirements and narrative constraints preserved.
- [ ] Tests added/updated where applicable.
- [ ] Security, localization, and error handling considered.
- [ ] Documentation updated if applicable.

## Documentation and evidence review
- [ ] Updated the owning document and linked it from the index as needed; avoided repeated current-status narratives.
- [ ] Historical commands/results are labeled as dated and not executable on the current VM.
- [ ] Evidence states what was actually verified and what remains untested.
- [ ] Documentation checks, local links, Markdown structure and OpenAPI validations pass (or exceptions explained).
- [ ] No private canonical PDFs, credentials, session contents, unpublished narrative or raw backups were committed.
